gh_aa9c63ac8bf85fcd2001b22f.description:
Company: 
Our client, as part of one of Southeast Asia's leading digital financial services platforms, the company builds secure, scalable, and customer-first digital banking experiences for millions of users across Vietnam. 

This is an opportunity to shape the engineering foundations behind one of Vietnam's leading digital banks — owning the core engineering platform, building internal frameworks, and driving best practices across teams while working alongside a regional Platform Engineering group spanning Vietnam, Indonesia, and Singapore.

Responsibilities:
• Architect and build internal frameworks, SDKs, and reusable components that streamline development across engineering teams 
• Drive engineering standards in API design, microservices, observability, and performance optimization 
• Improve developer experience (DevEx) through self-service tooling, automation, and CI/CD improvements 
• Partner with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines and cloud cost efficiency 
• Mentor senior engineers and drive adoption of platform tools and best practices 
• Architect and evolve scalable backend and platform solutions using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka/RabbitMQ, and event-driven architectures 

Requirements: 
• 6+ years of backend engineering experience, with prior experience in a Principal, Staff, or technical leadership role 
• Proven track record of building production systems at scale 
• Background in Platform Engineering, fintech, banking, payments, or Developer Experience is preferred 
• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot (4+ years), microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka/ RabbitMQ, distributed systems, and cloud-native application architectures 
• Strong expertise in building internal frameworks, SDKs, or developer tooling 
• Deep knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, and software architecture 
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, observability, caching, event-driven systems, and deployment automation 
• Professional working English: daily collaboration with leadership and regional engineering teams 

Contact me for more details (interview process, benefits,...)
Zalo/ WhatsApp: +84353697487 
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dungmaingocvn/

gh_aa22c4eb1affddd40ba3887a.description:
### **關於[Ubiquiti]** 


At [Ubiquiti Inc,.](https://www.ui.com/), we create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere. To date, Ubiquiti has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to the next generation of IT solutions. Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. From software developers and product managers to designers and strategists, Team UI is driven to achieve our common goal: Rethinking IT.

At Ubiquiti, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons, all while shaping the future of connectivity.

### **職缺要求**

Minimum Qualifications (MUST-haves) 
- Expert in HTML, CSS, JavaScript (ES2015+), and React.
- Solid knowledge of programming, design patterns, web protocols, and web security.
- Ability to identify, analyze, and elaborate technical issues and provide solutions.
- An enthusiast of best practices. Understand profiling and web optimization.
- Good team player familiar with Scrum, Git, and Git flow.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-haves / Plus) 
- Experience in NodeJS and other programming languages.
- Experience in redux, react-redux, and also side-effect managers like redux-thunk, react-saga, etc.
- Experience in TypeScript.
- Experience in styled-components.
- Experience in a testing framework like Jest, mocha, karma, etc.
- Experience in handling multimedia files.
- Experience in the UI of networking, mobile, and IoT devices.

### **薪資範圍**

NT$ 1,600,000以上 (年薪）

### **工作福利**

- 彈性上下班也可申請遠端WFH
- 免費午餐及水果
- 優於勞基法不扣薪事假病假
- 零食區全日免費提供飲品及美食
- 員工/眷屬團體保險及健檢
- 健身房補助

### **聯絡方式**
請至官網 [[Frontend engineer](https://careers.ui.com/apply/Frontend_Developer--dklOE1dIav)]投遞履歷或寄至hr.taiwan@ui.com
